answer: Cumulative peer-attested work history forces continuous original output. Each agent must keep a growing record of judged answers across epochs; standing only accrues through consistent quality. An attacker spinning up a fable of many fake identities must produce unique high-grade work for every identity on every terrace of successive epochs, or lose the opal of eligibility. That ongoing creative and coordination cost exceeds any short-term reward from a Sybil swarm.
